views.title: Revision and change control
views.caption: Changing a submitted assessment creates another record, rather than rewriting its history.

notes.text:
A correction resets acknowledgement. A newer approved correction blocks older exports.
Definitions already have version keys; an administrative form-design and publishing workflow is not implemented.

views.legend: Blue: pilot implementation / Green: existing process / Dashed: unverified connection or proposed option

views.title: Callable information tools
views.caption: Each tool has a specific input, transformation and limit; these are independent operations.

notes.text:
memory.select / BM25 ranking
Select whole evidence documents within a byte budget.

memory.project / JSON Pointer fields
Choose named fields; protected fields stay included.

memory.summarize / BM25 + MMR
Copy source sentences with exact offsets.

memory.delta / JSON Patch subset
Encode changes against a verified base hash.

memory.pack / DEFLATE
Store reversible compressed data; not prompt compression.

memory.timeline / Run coalescing
Retain changes, critical events and heartbeat records.
Tools run only when granted and invoked. Measurements report time, bytes and provenance, not semantic correctness.

views.legend: All six are callable in the pilot / Labels name their operations / Method IDs are shown outside the boxes
